property_action.reference: an attach wrote a root generation at or below one the root slots held
property_action.reason: The rule states the clause "every relaunch writes its tenure session above every generation the slots held" of the obligation record reset-roots-leave-no-older-root-selectable: an attach breaks that clause when it writes a root whose generation is at or below the generation both root slots held before the tenure's checkpoint passes. A refusal that writes no root and leaves both slots at that generation keeps the clause. The history rs1-wide-unit-roots-lost fails the rule at the head, its sibling rs1-wide-unit-without-pass refuses StaleSession without a root write and passes, and the control rs1-without-pass-reissued fails the rule through the standing plant Plant::GenerationReuse, whose RESET writes the held generation itself.
